fn rs_constant_syntax(stage: *RsStage, expression: *RmdExpr) -> unit {
    if expression == null(*RmdExpr) || (*stage).failed { return; }
    if (*expression).syntax_type != null(*RmdTypeSyntax) {
        (*expression).syntax_type = rs_lower_type(stage, (*expression).syntax_type);
    }
    rs_constant_syntax(stage, (*expression).left);
    rs_constant_syntax(stage, (*expression).right);
    var index: usize = 0usize;
    while index < (*expression).arg_count && !(*stage).failed {
        rs_constant_syntax(stage, (*expression).args[index]);
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    var item: *RmdInit = (*expression).inits;
    while item != null(*RmdInit) && !(*stage).failed {
        rs_constant_syntax(stage, (*item).value);
        item = (*item).next;
    }
}

// Copy an initializer within the semantic nesting limit and lower its source types.
// Preserve the source tree. Seed constant checking must follow this operation.
fn rs_lower_constant(stage: *RsStage, expression: *RmdExpr) -> *RmdExpr {
    var result: *RmdExpr = rs_clone_expr(stage, expression);
    rs_constant_syntax(stage, result);
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdExpr); }
    return result;
}

fn rs_constant_source(stage: *RsStage, expression: *RmdExpr, expected: *RmdTypeSyntax) -> unit {
    if (*stage).failed { return; }
    var kind: u32 = (*expression).kind;
    var location: *RmdLoc = &(*expression).loc;
    if kind == RMD_E_GROUP {
        rs_constant_source(stage, (*expression).left, expected);
        return;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_NAME {
        var global: *RsGlobal = rs_global(stage, (*expression).name);
        if (*global).unsafe_call || (*global).drop_only {
            rs_error(stage, location, "constant initializer cannot retain an unsafe function");
            return;
        }
        if !rs_same(stage, (*global).syntax, expected) {
            rs_error(stage, location, "constant function value has incompatible source types or borrow modes");
        }
        return;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_NULL || kind == RMD_E_RECORD || kind == RMD_E_ARRAY {
        if !rs_same(stage, (*expression).syntax_type, expected) {
            rs_error(stage, location, "constant initializer has incompatible source types or borrow modes");
            return;
        }
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_RECORD {
        var global: *RsGlobal = rs_global(stage, (*expected).name);
        var fields: RmdMap = make RmdMap { entries: null(*RmdMapEntry), count: 0usize, capacity: 0usize };
        var field: *RmdField = (*(*global).source).fields;
        while field != null(*RmdField) && !(*stage).failed {
            rs_put(stage, &fields, (*field).name as usize, (*field).syntax_type as *u8);
            field = (*field).next;
        }
        var item: *RmdInit = (*expression).inits;
        while item != null(*RmdInit) && !(*stage).failed {
            var syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax = rmd_map_get(&fields, (*item).name as usize) as *RmdTypeSyntax;
            rs_constant_source(stage, (*item).value, syntax);
            item = (*item).next;
        }
        return;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_ARRAY {
        var index: usize = 0usize;
        while index < (*expression).arg_count && !(*stage).failed {
            rs_constant_source(stage, (*expression).args[index], (*expected).base);
            index = index + 1usize;
        }
    }
}

fn rs_constant_typed(stage: *RsStage, expression: *RmdExpr) -> unit {
    if expression == null(*RmdExpr) || (*stage).failed { return; }
    var kind: u32 = (*expression).kind;
    var location: *RmdLoc = &(*expression).loc;
    if kind == RMD_E_UNARY && ((*expression).op == RMD_OP_ADDRESS || (*expression).op == RMD_OP_DEREF) {
        rs_error(stage, location, "constant initializer cannot access a raw address");
        return;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_BINARY && ((*expression).op == RMD_OP_ADD || (*expression).op == RMD_OP_SUB) {
        if (*(*(*expression).left).type).kind == RMD_T_POINTER || (*(*(*expression).right).type).kind == RMD_T_POINTER {
            rs_error(stage, location, "constant initializer cannot perform pointer arithmetic");
            return;
        }
    }
    if (kind == RMD_E_FIELD || kind == RMD_E_INDEX) && (*(*(*expression).left).type).kind == RMD_T_POINTER {
        rs_error(stage, location, "constant initializer cannot access a raw pointer");
        return;
    }
    if kind == RMD_E_CAST {
        var from: u32 = (*(*(*expression).left).type).kind;
        var into: u32 = (*(*expression).type).kind;
        if from == RMD_T_POINTER || from == RMD_T_FUNCTION || into == RMD_T_POINTER || into == RMD_T_FUNCTION {
            rs_error(stage, location, "constant initializer cannot cast a pointer or function value");
            return;
        }
    }
    rs_constant_typed(stage, (*expression).left);
    rs_constant_typed(stage, (*expression).right);
    var index: usize = 0usize;
    while index < (*expression).arg_count && !(*stage).failed {
        rs_constant_typed(stage, (*expression).args[index]);
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    var item: *RmdInit = (*expression).inits;
    while item != null(*RmdInit) && !(*stage).failed {
        rs_constant_typed(stage, (*item).value);
        item = (*item).next;
    }
}

// Require successful seed constant checking of the lowered target units.
// Check source function effects and borrow modes before any target emission.
fn rs_check_constants(stage: *RsStage) -> bool {
    var global: *RsGlobal = (*stage).first_global;
    while global != null(*RsGlobal) && !(*stage).failed {
        if (*(*global).source).kind == RMD_D_CONST {
            rs_constant_source(stage, (*(*global).source).init, (*global).syntax);
            rs_constant_typed(stage, (*(*global).lowered).init);
        }
        global = (*global).next;
    }
    return !(*stage).failed;
}
